 News School Holiday Clinics on sale now
 12 Aug
 1
 min read
 Share on social
 Facebook Link 
 Linkedin Link 
 Linkedin Link 
 Linkedin Link 
 October is fast approaching and the Adelaide 36ers will be hosting not one, but two School Holiday clinics, proudly supported by HomeStart Finance. 
 Run by club legends and community coaches Brett Maher and Scott Ninnis, the HomeStart Finance Adelaide 36ers School Holiday Clinics are held during each school holiday period and are aimed at children of all ages, genders and abilities.
 In October, the club is offering two, two-day clinics, which will perfect an environment for tomorrow's NBL stars to enhance their skills and to learn from some of the best in the game.
 All clinic attendees will recieve a free family pass to one of the first four 36ers home games at the Adelaide Entertainment Centre this season.
 The clinics sell out fast, so to book your spot, click here.
